lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 12 distinct vertical line segments observed. The central 6 lines are high-contrast and spaced at approximately regular intervals across the mid-section, while the 3 anterior and 3 posterior segments are shorter or lower in contrast.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The 1st and 2nd anterior lines are abbreviated, terminating mid-shoulder. The posterior lines (10-12) are fragmented into dashes and dots, failing to reach the ventral or dorsal boundaries.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A localized grouping of approximately 8 high-contrast spots is visible on the upper hind limb/haunch area, positioned between the primary vertical stripes and the tail.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Four spots on the lower haunch align to form a semi-linear horizontal row approximately parallel to the knee joint.

macro_horn_vector_geometry.curve_trajectory_2d: The horns exhibit a lyrate, spiral trajectory curving backwards and upwards. The primary visible horn displays an approximate 140-degree arc from the base to the apical tip relative to the facial plane.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.terminal_contrast_ratio: The high-contrast ivory-colored tips comprise approximately 15% of the total visible vertical length of the horn structure.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a white chevron patch across the bridge of the muzzle, a white transverse patch on the lower throat, and a long dark ventral hair fringe extending from the chest to the inguinal region.
